question: Should OpenClaw remove these shipped root bundled skills now and require affected users to install owner-qualified ClawHub replacements?
rationale: The lean-core direction supports externalization, but the acceptable deprecation window, migration behavior, and release support burden are product choices that source inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Migrate before trimming
options.body: Keep the planned trim but add a tested doctor or install migration that converts existing shipped references before the bundles disappear.

options.title: Accept the breaking trim
options.body: Land the removals as an intentional compatibility break with explicit release ownership and support guidance.

options.title: Split Sherpa only
options.body: Move the narrower Sherpa packaging work to its own landing path and park the bundled-skill removals.

recommendation.title: Migrate before trimming
recommendation.body: Keep the planned trim but add a tested doctor or install migration that converts existing shipped references before the bundles disappear.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the related split-work history and has the clearest recent context for the remaining product boundary.
